purpose: MonoMVSNet (ICCV 2025, MIT; DAv2 ViT-S Apache + TEED MIT) as a second MVS engine on the 132-image scene, fused with the OFFICIAL CasDiffMVS filter so the gate is identical to the casdiff pane

input.cam_convention: general_eval_vit.read_cam_file divides K rows 0-1 by 4 and stage4 multiplies by 4 => cam.txt must hold FULL-RES K (first attempt with K*4 gave garbage: |rel|<1% vs CasDiffMVS only 2-4%)

fusion.own_dypcd_DTU_thresholds: final mask ~1% => 104 MB ply, unusable (DTU mm-scale thresholds: dist<0.5*i px, rel<log10(i)*0.001)
fusion.official_casdiffmvs_filter: diffmvs/filter.py::filter_depth(pair, out, ply, 3, 1.0, 0.01, [0.55,0.55,0.55], 'casdiffmvs', 'general'); conf0/1/2 all -> MonoMVSNet single confidence; cams line 11 must carry 'depth_max depth_min' (zeros => geo mask 0)

verdict: USER (09-07): 'MonoMVSNet的白墙粘连比CasDiffMVS更严重' => second engine rejected; monocular prior + edge-guided sampling did not reduce wall-object sticking, it worsened it
